hook: Lakdikapul tests a *one-way* loop on November 22
hook_b: Lakdikapul tests a *one-way* loop on November 22
tldr: Traffic police and GHMC will trial a one-way system between Ravindra Bharathi, Lakdikapul and Iqbal Minar on Nov 22.

beats.what: Vehicles from Old Control Room to Iqbal Minar will be diverted at Ravindra Bharathi via HDFC Junction and old Saifabad police station.
beats.why: Police say Lakdikapul has faced congestion for several years and this followed a detailed study.
beats.care: If you pass Ravindra Bharathi, Iqbal Minar or Secretariat on Nov 22, expect a changed route.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat: Officials will meet traders, residents and commuters before the trial and consider objections.

cards.q: Should Lakdikapul switch to one-way if the trial data is good?

qs: Which trips get longer under a one-way loop, and which get shorter?

facts.t: Route covers *6 points*: Lakdikapul, Iqbal Minar, Ravindra Bharathi, Old Control Room, HDFC Jn, old Saifabad PS.

watch: What the Nov 22 travel-time data shows and whether the plan is made permanent.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Lakdikapul one-way traffic: Trial run on November 22

fact: Lakdikapul gets a *one-day one-way traffic trial* on November 22.
twist: The final call depends on trial data: travel time, congestion, junction performance and safety.
